concurrency_and_state: WhisArenaMatch, WhisArenaPvPMatch, WhisArenaBossMatch, WhisArenaBotVsBotMatch each spawn a dedicated Thread.ofVirtual() loop sleeping ~1000ms per tick; isFinished is non-volatile in WhisArenaMatch/PvPMatch/BossMatch/BotVsBotMatch despite cross-thread reads/writes.

WhisArenaBotManager.lobbyBots and bots use CopyOnWriteArrayList; update() runs on GameLoopManager every 150ms and calls tryMatchmaking() which mutates zone/match state concurrently with player request threads.

WhisArenaService.readyPlayerIds is ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet(), modified unsynchronized in WhisArenaService.findMatch() while iterated under synchronized(readyIds) in WhisArenaLobbyBot.tryMatchmaking().
WhisArenaService synchronizes DB I/O (addReward, clearRewards, claimRewards) and matchmaking zone lookup (getFreeZone, getFreeZoneInMap) on the same singleton monitor.
NgocRongNamecService runs a daemon Thread.sleep(1000) loop mutating zone.items directly from its own thread without zone locking.

PhoBan services (DestronGasService, SnakeWayService, TreasureUnderSeaService, RedRibbonHQService, SuperDivineWaterService) check and allocate shared instance pools and clan fields without synchronization.
DeathOrAliveArenaService.startChallenge defers adding DeathOrAliveArena to DeathOrAliveArenaManager by 500ms via setTimeout, leaving getMapChallenge(112) unprotected against concurrent claims.
cross_module_questions: Does Client or Controller validate byte x before calling BlackBallWarService.xHPKI(player, x) / xDame(player, x), or can a client send arbitrary x != 3/5/7?
How is Client opcode -96 (typeTop=0) parsed against WhisArenaService.showLeaderboard, and how does opcode -118 map targetId to WhisArenaService.competing(player, int targetId) when player.id is long?
Under what NPC menu conditions can a player invoke DeathOrAliveArenaService.cancelChallenge(player) — can it be triggered after round 0 starts?
Is Zone.getPlayers() / Zone.items backed by a thread-safe collection or copy, given concurrent iteration/mutation by NgocRongNamecService, BlackBallWarService, and GameLoop?
How does PlayerDAO.updatePlayer(player) handle concurrent saves when DeathOrAliveArenaWeeklyService.rewardAndReset() updates DB directly via UPDATE player SET arena_wins = 0?

db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Uses try-with-resources and backticks; however addReward() does not load existing DB rows first if pendingArenaRewards cache is cold, so saveRewardsToDB() overwrites existing DB rewards.

db_redis_touchpoints.op: INSERT INTO `whis_arena_rewards` ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `rewards` = ?
db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Uses try-with-resources and backticks; executed synchronously inside synchronized WhisArenaService.addReward() while holding singleton lock.
Uses try-with-resources and backticks; executed inside synchronized clearRewards()/claimRewards().
N+1 DB queries (up to 15 sequential player loads) inside getLeaderboardEntries() on every leaderboard view or findMatch() call.

db_redis_touchpoints.op: SELECT id, name, arena_wins FROM player WHERE arena_wins > 0 ORDER BY arena_wins DESC, id ASC LIMIT 5
db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Uses try-with-resources; no transaction spans reward distribution, UPDATE reset, and JSON file write.
Uses try-with-resources; resets DB before resetting online players in RAM (lines 179-183), creating a window where logout/PlayerDAO.updatePlayer can write stale arenaWins back.
Synchronous full-player DB persistence on match end / challenge start / reward claim.

findings.impact: If client supplies any byte x other than X3/X5/X7, player gets up to x127 HP/KI/Dame multiplier for 0 gems.
findings.root_cause: xHPKI() and xDame() initialize cost=0 and only assign cost in switch cases X3/X5/X7 without a default rejection, then check checkGemAndRuby(0) (true) and assign effectSkin.xHPKI = x / xDame = x.
findings.title: Unvalidated multiplier byte in xHPKI/xDame grants free stat multiplier

findings.impact: Two players can double-claim/lock the same Namek Ball, or two clan members can open duplicate dungeon instances and bypass cooldown/item limits.
findings.root_cause: Check-then-act on shared dungeon pools (isOpened / getClan() == null), clan dungeon slots, daily counters, item consumption, and Namek ball arrays lack synchronization.
findings.title: Unsynchronized check-then-act on Namek ball pickup and PhoBan instance allocation

findings.impact: Two players can be assigned the same zone simultaneously, overwrite each other's arena match, and lose entry tickets/water bottles; disconnecting during the 500ms delay leaves player.isPKDHVT=true.
findings.root_cause: getMapChallenge(112) checks DeathOrAliveArenaManager.getVDST(zone) == null synchronously, but new DeathOrAliveArena() is not added to DeathOrAliveArenaManager until 500ms later inside setTimeout().
findings.title: 500ms TOCTOU window in DeathOrAliveArenaService.startChallenge allows double-booking arena zones

findings.impact: Players who win Round 4 with at least 1 empty bag slot receive 2 Capsule Vangs instead of 1 (one in Whis mailbox and one directly in bag).
findings.root_cause: onBossDie() unconditionally calls WhisArenaService.gI().addReward(player, 574) at line 339, and then at lines 344-349 also creates and adds ConstItem.CAPSULE_VANG directly to bag when getCountEmptyBag(player) > 0.
findings.title: Double Capsule Vang reward on winning Whis Arena U6 Round 4

findings.impact: Winning a Whis Arena match before getRewards() loads existing rewards from DB permanently wipes all previously stored unclaimed rewards in whis_arena_rewards.
findings.root_cause: addReward() uses pendingArenaRewards.computeIfAbsent(playerId, k -> new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>()) without loading from DB first, and saveRewardsToDB() executes ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rewards = ? overwriting the DB JSON array.
findings.title: WhisArenaService.addReward overwrites uncached DB rewards on cold cache

findings.impact: Same zone can host overlapping matches, same player can be matched twice (findMatch + LobbyBot.tryMatchmaking), and same LobbyBot can be pulled into two concurrent fights.
findings.root_cause: getFreeZone() returns a zone without atomically marking zone.isCompeting=true; readyPlayerIds is mutated unsynchronized while iterated under synchronized(readyIds); LobbyBot state transitions to FIGHTING are not atomic/synchronized.
findings.title: TOCTOU races in WhisArena matchmaking, zone reservation, and LobbyBot state transitions

findings.impact: Crash during Sunday reset can cause double weekly gem payouts, stale arenaWins persistence on logout, or corrupted vdst_weekly.json losing unclaimed records.
findings.root_cause: rewardAndReset() performs SELECT, gem payout + PlayerDAO.updatePlayer, UPDATE player SET arena_wins = 0, RAM reset, and FileWriter saveData() without a DB transaction or atomic file write; RAM reset happens after SQL UPDATE.
findings.title: Non-atomic weekly VDST reset and non-atomic JSON persistence

findings.impact: IndexOutOfBoundsException, skipped items, byte overflow (>127 items), or ConcurrentModificationException during Namek ball/stone cleanup.
findings.root_cause: removeStoneNrNamec() uses a byte loop index j and calls zone.items.remove(j) in a forward loop without decrementing j and without synchronizing on zone.items while running on its own thread.
findings.title: Unsafe removal and byte index overflow in NgocRongNamecService.removeStoneNrNamec

findings.impact: After a match ends via fallOut(), update() executes die() and leaveMap() in the same tick on nulled player fields, re-triggering finish()/dispose() and throwing NPEs (silently caught).
findings.root_cause: fallOut() invokes finish() -> dispose() which nulls player_1, player_2, npc, and zone, yet update() immediately calls die() and leaveMap() afterward; leaveMap() treats player_2==null as forfeit and calls finish() again. Also init() calls npc.location without null check.
findings.title: Double finish() invocation and NPEs in WorldMartialArtsTournament

findings.impact: Opening the Whis Arena leaderboard or clicking findMatch blocks on up to 15 synchronous DB queries and sorts a CopyOnWriteArrayList while holding/blocking service operations.
findings.root_cause: getLeaderboardEntries() runs NDVSqlFetcher.loadById() per topArena entry in a loop and calls sortBots() on a CopyOnWriteArrayList; WhisArenaService synchronizes JDBC queries on the same singleton lock used by getFreeZone().
findings.title: N+1 DB queries in WhisArenaBotManager and singleton lock contention with DB I/O in WhisArenaService

findings.impact: Two concurrent players in different zones fighting the same U6 Boss round or player clone share identical entity IDs; BotVsBot matches lock Zone 0 (the main lobby) for competing.
findings.root_cause: WhisArenaU6Boss uses fixed IDs -30001 - round and clone bots use (int) -plTarget.id; WhisArenaLobbyBot.startBotVsBotMatch selects b1.lobbyZone (Map 186 Zone 0) when !isCompeting instead of isolating bot matches to non-lobby zones.
findings.title: Boss/clone ID collisions and BotVsBot matches occupying Map 186 Zone 0 lobby

findings.impact: NullPointerException if player is null when calling tnsmLuyenTapUp; player loses 1 gem if disconnecting during the 1000ms schedule delay; SuperDivineWaterService strands player if Pocolo creation fails and heals MP with hpMax.
findings.root_cause: TrainingService.tnsmLuyenTapUp dereferences player.lastTimeOffline before null-checking player and deducts 1 gem before scheduled execution; SuperDivineWaterService sets callBossPocolo=true even if new Pocolo() throws, passes hpMax as MP to hsChar, and doesn't null-check mc; MajinBuuService.joinMapMabu ignores clanmate's cFlag.
findings.title: Null-check, resource-order, and flag assignment defects in Training/SuperDivineWater/MajinBuu services

findings.impact: If write/send throws IOException, the Netty-backed Message buffer in sendTypePK is never released.
findings.root_cause: msg.cleanup() is placed inside the try block instead of a finally block.
findings.title: Missing finally cleanup for Message in DeathOrAliveArenaService.sendTypePK

findings.impact: Whis Arena ignores the 21:00-22:00 schedule and auto-grants demo rewards to admins in production unless toggled off.
findings.title: WhisArenaService.TEST_MODE_24_7 left enabled

module_summary: Batch p06 covers Whis Arena (bot manager, lobby bots, PvE/PvP/BotVsBot/U6 Boss matches, service/DB rewards), WorldMartialArtsTournament, DeathOrAliveArena (VDST service and weekly reset), and 10 dungeon/event services (BlackBallWar, DestronGas, MajinBuu, MajinBuu14H, NgocRongNamec, RedRibbonHQ, SnakeWay, SuperDivineWater, Training, TreasureUnderSea). Key risks include an unvalidated stat multiplier exploit in BlackBallWarService, race conditions on zone/instance/ball allocation across VDST, Whis Arena, Namek balls, and clan dungeons, a double Capsule Vang reward in WhisArenaBossMatch, DB reward overwrite in WhisArenaService, non-atomic weekly VDST reset, and unsafe concurrent mutation in NgocRongNamecService.

protocol_touchpoints.payload_summary: byte typeTop=0, UTF headerTitle, byte count, followed by per-entry int rank, int id, short head, (if version>214) short -1, short body, short leg, UTF name, UTF info1, UTF info2
int (int) boss.id, byte 3 (PK type); msg.cleanup() omitted on IOException path
